import sys,os,json,hashlib,threading,tempfile,time
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
sys.path.insert(0,str(Path.cwd()/'tools'))
import measure_browser_instructions as measurement
from page_archive import Replay
from process_instruction_counts import MacCounters
from chatgpt_browser_instructions import vox_replay_environment
out=Path('Build/site-opt-github-20261108').resolve()
replay=Replay(out/'original/archive',out/'replay')
threading.Thread(target=replay.server.serve_forever,daemon=True).start()
measurement.VOX_TOOLBAR_HEIGHT=88
measurement.VOX_CHROME_HEIGHT=112
binary=Path('Build/v/Vox.app/Contents/MacOS/Vox').resolve()
sha=lambda p:hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
pins={str(p):sha(p) for p in [binary,*binary.parent.glob('*.dylib'),binary.with_name('VoxAdblockWorker')]}
(out/'pins.json').write_text(json.dumps(pins,indent=2))
config=out/'audit-config.json'
config.write_text(json.dumps(dict(selectors=[dict(name='rows',selector='tr.react-directory-row',limit=100,attributes=['id']),dict(name='links',selector='tr.react-directory-row a[href]',limit=100,attributes=['href'])],describe_native_errors=True)))
results=[]
try:
 for i,kind in enumerate(['control','candidate','candidate','control']):
  if any(sha(Path(p))!=value for p,value in pins.items()):raise RuntimeError('Shared runtime changed; cohort rejected')
  with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='profile-',dir=out) as profile, tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='cache-',dir=out) as cache:
   env={k:v for k,v in os.environ.items() if not k.startswith(('VOX_','LADYBIRD_','GC_')) and not k.lower().endswith('_proxy')}
   env.update(vox_replay_environment(replay.ready['proxy'],replay.ready['ca'],True))
   env.update(VOX_ADBLOCK_ENGINE_ASSETS=str(out/'control-assets' if kind=='control' else Path('adblock').resolve()),VOX_PROFILE_DIR=profile,VOX_TEST_WINDOW='1',VOX_CAPTURE_AUDIT_PATH=str(out/f'{i}-{kind}.audit.json'),VOX_CAPTURE_AUDIT_CONFIG=str(config))
   os.environ.clear();os.environ.update(env)
   args=SimpleNamespace(binary=binary,url='https://github.com/vlang/v',width=1024,height=768,timeout=90,settle_seconds=2,sample_interval=.005,vox_arg=['--enable-javascript','--screenshot-viewport-height','768'])
   prefix=out/f'{i}-{kind}'
   r=measurement.run_vox(args,prefix,MacCounters(),Path(cache))
   r.update(kind=kind,started_at=time.time(),audit=json.loads(Path(str(prefix)+'.audit.json').read_text()),host_load=os.getloadavg(),cpu_count=os.cpu_count())
   (out/f'{i}-{kind}.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2));results.append(r)
   print(json.dumps(dict(kind=kind,instructions=r['instructions'],title=r['audit'].get('title'),ready=r['audit'].get('ready'),diagnostics=r['audit'].get('javascript_diagnostics'),selections=[(x['name'],x['count']) for x in r['audit'].get('selections',[])])),flush=True)
finally:
 (out/'diagnostic-summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(results=results,pins=pins,stable=all(sha(Path(p))==v for p,v in pins.items())),indent=2))
 replay.server.shutdown();replay.server.server_close()
